scope: Read-only Chrome worker CPU profile of unchanged retained production Vite bundle
interpretation: ScalePoint accounts for 829/1388 = 59.7% of shuffle samples; point encoding accounts for 13.4%, and round permutation for 7.5%. These stack-based categories are mutually exclusive by nearest listed operation, and sampling is approximate. The 64-round proof protocol and byte transcript were unchanged. No multiplyUnsafe was introduced or used in prover code.
limitations: A separate focused VP crypto test may have overlapped the timing runs, so no run is claimed as isolated acceptance.
